login.title: Link a {{name}} account
login.instructions: Open the authorization page, sign in and enter the code below.

apiKey.title: Add a {{name}} API key
apiKey.instructions: Enter the API key. It is checked with the provider before it is saved.
apiKey.label: API key

remove.affectedAgents: {{name}} models used by {{agents}} stop working until an account is linked again.
remove.credentialsNotice: The sign-in of this {{name}} account is deleted.

problems.loginExpired: The login has expired. Sign in again.
problems.invalidApiKey: The API key is invalid. Enter it again.
problems.quotaExhausted: The quota is used up. The account resumes automatically once it recovers.
problems.rateLimited: Too many requests. The account recovers shortly.
problems.upstreamError: The provider refused this account (HTTP {{status}}). It may lack access or have been suspended.
problems.upstreamUnstable: The provider is failing temporarily (HTTP {{status}}). Retrying automatically.
problems.upstreamUnreachable: The provider can't be reached right now. Retrying automatically.
problems.modelQuotaExhausted: The {{provider}} account's quota for this model is used up. It can be used again once it recovers.
problems.modelForbidden: The {{provider}} account isn't allowed to use this model (HTTP {{status}}).
problems.checkFailed: Couldn't reach the provider to check the account. The status is unchanged.
problems.noToken: This account has no usable login token.
problems.loginStartFailed: Couldn't start the {{provider}} login. Try again later.
problems.loginTimeout: Timed out. Enter the key again.
problems.loginSaveFailed: Logged in, but the credentials couldn't be saved. Try again.
problems.duplicateApiKey: This API key has already been added.
problems.keyCheckUnavailable: Couldn't reach {{provider}} to check the API key. Try again later.
problems.unsupported: This connector doesn't support that action.
problems.gatewayUnavailable: The model service is unavailable right now. Try again later.

connectorHints.codex: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. If the authorization page says device-code login isn't allowed, turn on device code authorization for Codex under Security in ChatGPT settings first.
connectorHints.xai: Requires an xAI account that can use the Grok API (for example, a SuperGrok subscription).
connectorHints.gemini: Create an API key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey), then enter it here.
